repo.description:
### Background

NATS is an open source messaging system for cloud, on-premises and edge deployments.

NATS Server supports no_auth_user for clients that connect without explicit credentials and can delegate authentication decisions to an authorization callout.

### Problem Description

The pre-CONNECT protocol path could register the configured no_auth_user without consulting the authorization callout. A connection rejected by the normal authentication flow could therefore be admitted with that user’s permissions. The issue affects deployments that combine these features.

### Affected Versions

The issue is fixed in v2.12.14, v2.14.4 and v2.15.0. Earlier versions containing the affected functionality are vulnerable; the first affected version has not been established for this notice.

### Workarounds

Remove no_auth_user from the server configuration and, if configured, from the websocket block. Clients must then use the normal authentication handshake. Upgrade to a fixed release.

### References

 * GHSA advisory: <https://github.com/nats-io/nats-server/security/advisories/GHSA-g9p6-654w-mr9v>
 * Credit: Taeyoung Jeong (@ttzero25)
repo.summary: Pre-CONNECT no_auth_user handling can bypass authorization callouts
